scripts.build: vite build && node tools/copy-static.mjs && node tools/optimize-images.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:source && npm run build && npm run test:build
scripts.check:fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format
scripts.app:icons: npm exec --yes --package @tauri-apps/cli@2.12.4 -- tauri icon src-tauri/icons/source.svg --output src-tauri/icons
scripts.app:build: npm run app:icons && npm exec --yes --package @tauri-apps/cli@2.12.4 -- tauri build
scripts.app:android:init: npm exec --yes --package @tauri-apps/cli@2.12.4 -- tauri android init --ci && npm run app:icons
scripts.app:android:build: npm run app:icons && node tools/configure-android-immersive.mjs && npm exec --yes --package @tauri-apps/cli@2.12.4 -- tauri android build --apk
